items.title: Note editor undo/redo: Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z act on the note edit overlay's editor, with the undo history scoped to a single open-to-close editing session and covering only the note body

evidence.summary: Note-editor undo/redo. New UI-free NoteEditHistory value type: a session-scoped undo/redo stack over the note body alone. It is deliberately NOT the text view's NSUndoManager - that one is the window's, which holds the project layer's own undo entries (Hide/Show Project, Apply Layout), so routing Cmd+Z there would let a note edit undo a workspace change. Typing coalesces (single-character edits within 0.75 s collapse into one step) while any larger change - paste, cut, selection replacement - always starts its own step, so a >10-line paste is taken back by one press; an undo closes the current run so the next keystroke cannot fold into the step just left; recording an unchanged value is a no-op, which is what makes writing an undone value back into the draft safe. ProjectNoteEditor creates the history from the note at open (so the first Cmd+Z returns to the text the editor opened with and no further), records every draft change, and takes Cmd+Z / Cmd+Shift+Z in the existing overlay keyDown monitor before any dispatch - the same path that made Cmd+A/C/X/V reliable. Priority and deadline are outside the history, as must-32 specifies. 7 new tests.

items.title: Model layer: remote-split determination - from a pane's OSC 7 pwd report decide local launch vs ssh launch to the reported host at the reported path, treating a host-less or unparseable report as local; covered by XGhosttyTests. If this cannot be done without modifying the upstream terminal core, stop and raise a Human-input Recommendation instead of touching the core

evidence.summary: Remote-split model layer plus the upstream-core path the human approved in R-013 (a). Core, scope-limited to carrying the report with no VT semantics change: apprt.surface.Message.pwd_change becomes PwdChange {path, host} instead of a bare WriteReq; stream_handler.reportPwd no longer drops a non-local OSC 7 report - it extracts the path first and, when internal_os.hostname.isLocal says the host is not ours, forwards path + host to the apprt and returns WITHOUT calling terminal.setPwd or touching the window title, so the terminal's own pwd (and everything that inherits it, e.g. a new project's working directory) stays exactly as it was when the report was discarded outright; a local report travels the old path with an empty host. Surface.zig null-terminates both and passes them through apprt.action.Pwd, which gains a host field mirrored into xghostty_action_pwd_s (include/xghostty.h). Swift: SurfaceView keeps the new pwdReport (PaneLocationReport) alongside pwd, and pwdChanged assigns pwd only for a local report, so no local consumer (proxy icon, command palette, restorable state) can ever receive a path that is not on this machine. Model layer (macos/Sources/Features/Projects/ProjectRemoteSplit.swift, UI-free and pure): PaneLocationReport (host, path), PaneSplitLaunch (.local / .ssh(host:path:)) with the reconnect line as a computed property, and RemoteSplit.launch(for:) - remote only when the host is non-empty and not a loopback alias AND the path is absolute; every other shape is .local per must-61. The reconnect line is: ssh -t <host> '<cd <path> && exec ${SHELL:-/bin/sh} -l>', both levels shell-quoted through XGhostty.Shell.quote.

items.title: Wire the daily priority reset triggers: run the reset check at app launch and whenever the boundary is crossed while running (including wake from sleep and reactivation), with no notification or marker

evidence.summary: Daily priority reset triggers. Workday gains nextBoundary(after:calendar:) - the next local 06:00, resolved through Calendar.nextDate rather than by adding seconds so a DST transition moves it with the wall clock - keeping the 'when' of the boundary in the model beside the 'which day' (must-70). BaseTerminalController now installs the triggers at the end of init, after the restored workspace is in place, so a reset that is due at launch lands on the restored priorities: an immediate check, a Timer armed at the next boundary (added to RunLoop .common so a tracking loop cannot delay it, and rescheduled after every firing), NSApplication.didBecomeActiveNotification, and NSWorkspace.didWakeNotification. The last two exist because a sleeping or backgrounded Mac can pass 06:00 with the timer suspended; overlapping triggers are harmless because the model stamps the workday it ran for, making the reset idempotent within a workday. deinit invalidates the timer and detaches the NSWorkspace observer. No notification and no marker, and the reset never reorders (must-69). Two new tests pin the scheduled boundary and the once-per-workday behaviour of a running app.

items.notes: Human-diagnosed defect (2026-08-16 resume): OSSurfaceView.pwdReport is only ever written by pwdChanged and never cleared, while the bash shell integration suppresses a repeated OSC 7 for an unchanged PWD. Leaving ssh and returning to the same local PWD therefore leaves a remote report in place, and splitting that pane wrongly ssh's out. zsh recovers because it re-reports every precmd; bash does not. This breaks the second half of success criterion 19. Shell-integration scripts are upstream assets and must not be touched.

evidence.summary:
レポート陳腐化の修正。原因は「OSC 7 は変わったときしか報告されない」ことで、bash 統合は同一 PWD の再報告を抑止するため、ssh を抜けて同じディレクトリのローカルシェルに戻っても新しい報告が来ず、最後のリモート報告が残り続けていた。上流のシェル統合スクリプトは継承資産なので触らず、macOS アプリ層だけで解決した。

モデル層(ProjectRemoteSplit.swift、UI 非依存): (a) PaneForegroundProcess { shell / other / unknown } と classify(executablePath:) — 実行ファイル名を既知のシェル名集合(sh/bash/zsh/fish/dash/ash/ksh 系/csh 系/nu/elvish/xonsh、login shell の先頭 '-' を許容、大小文字無視)と照合する。取得不能は必ず .unknown で、決して .shell にしない。(b) PaneLocationTracker { report; record / reset / commandFinished(foreground:) / splitLaunch(foreground:) }。(c) RemoteSplit.launch(for:foreground:) — 前景がペイン自身のシェルなら、報告がどれだけリモートを主張していても .local。

根拠は pty の前景プロセスである: ペインが本当にリモートにいる間、前景にいるのは(ローカルの)ssh 等であり、手元のプロンプトに戻っていれば前景はペイン自身のシェルになる。取得は xghostty_surface_foreground_pid(pty の tcgetpgrp)+ proc_pidpath(PaneForegroundProbe.swift、失敗は全経路 .unknown)。

破棄規則は 2 つ: (1) command finished(OSC 133 D)時に前景がシェルなら報告を捨てる = ssh からの復帰。前景がシェル以外なら捨てない — リモートシェル自身のコマンド終了報告が同じストリームを流れてくるだけなので、リモート側が bash で再報告を抑止していてもリモート判定が維持される(既存機能の退行回避)。この処理は notifyOnCommandFinish の設定判定より前に置いた。(2) child exit 時に reset — 報告した当のシェルが消えたのだから報告も消え、終了済みペインを Enter で再開した新しいシェルは手元で始まる。

配線: OSSurfaceView.pwdReport を paneLocation(PaneLocationTracker)へ置き換え、recordPaneLocation / paneCommandFinished / resetPaneLocation / paneSplitLaunch を生やした。App.swift の split 経路は surfaceView.paneSplitLaunch() を使う。SPEC.md §29 に 29.3(レポートの鮮度)を追加し、§29.4 のテスト一覧を 15 件へ更新、README の Remote splits 節にも復帰時の挙動を明記。あわせて §29 冒頭の「上流ターミナルコアの改変は不要だった」という記述が実装(T-049 で人間承認 R-013(a) のもとコアに host 転送を入れている)と食い違っていたので実態に合わせて訂正した。

evidence.summary: Root cause confirmed in code: OverlayKeyDownMonitor installed its NSEvent local monitor once in onAppear with the initial handler closure and never repointed it, so after any re-render the monitor kept reading the first view snapshot's captured rows/columns — the second Cmd+arrow resolved the cursor against the pre-move order and moved a different row/column (exactly the human-observed defect). evidence.summary: IME-capable list cell editing (must 78), attacking the two causes of the break the human found. (1) The editor is now AppKit: new ProjectListCellEditor (an NSTextField NSViewRepresentable) replaces the SwiftUI TextField, because the overlay needs to read the field editor's hasMarkedText() and because the field must own first responder itself — SwiftUI's @FocusState is released synchronously when an edit starts, so nothing fights the field editor mid composition, and updateNSView never writes stringValue while composing. (2) The keystroke that starts an edit is replayed, not seeded: ProjectListCellEdit.started(on:column:) opens the session with an empty draft (original still kept for the cancel path), the starting NSEvent goes to ProjectListCellEditorHandle.pendingKeyEvent, and the handle replays it through the field editor's interpretKeyEvents([event]) the moment the field takes first responder — so the IME sees it as the first stroke of a composition instead of its raw character landing in the cell (English typing still reaches insertText:, so type-to-replace is unchanged). The routing judgment is model-layer and pure: ProjectListCellEdit.routing(for:shifted:composing:) sends every key to the editor while a marked string is up (Space converts, Enter commits the conversion, Escape cancels it) and otherwise keeps the §27.2 terminators exactly as they were (Escape cancels, Enter commits down / Shift+Enter up, Tab commits right / Shift+Tab left); the overlay only maps NSEvent to the ProjectListEditKeyPress cases and projects handle.isComposing into it. An IME cancel leaves the session live, so the following Enter / Escape read as commit / cancel again. Three new XGhosttyTests cover the empty-draft edit start and both halves of the routing table.
